name: Revenue Split
description: Lock satoshis so they can only be paid out to three fixed recipients (artist, collaborator, platform) at fixed percentages. Anyone can trigger the payout and pays its fee.

payer.name: Payer
payer.description: Funds a split, for example a listener paying for music. Chooses nothing about where the money goes beyond the split it pays into.

trigger.name: Trigger
trigger.description: Anyone who pays out a split. The trigger cannot keep any of it and pays the miner fee from their own coins.

fundSplit.name: Fund split
fundSplit.description: Lock $(<splitSatoshis>) satoshis so they can only be paid out to the three recipients.

payer.name: Fund split
payer.description: Provide the amount and the split: three recipient key hashes and the artist and collaborator basis points.

payout.name: Pay out split
payout.description: Send a split coin to its artist, collaborator and platform. Each share must be at least the dust limit (546 satoshis), or the network will not relay the payout.

trigger.name: Pay out split
trigger.description: Provide the split coin, its value and its parameters. Your own coins pay the miner fee.

fundSplitTransaction.name: Split funded
fundSplitTransaction.description: $(<splitSatoshis>) satoshis were locked to a revenue split.

payoutTransaction.name: Split paid out
payoutTransaction.description: $(<splitSatoshis>) satoshis were paid out to the artist, collaborator and platform.

splitInput.name: Split coin
splitInput.description: The revenue split coin being paid out.

splitOutput.name: Revenue split
splitOutput.description: Satoshis that can only be paid out to the three recipients of this split.

platformShareOutput.name: Platform share
platformShareOutput.description: $(platformShare) satoshis paid to the platform, including any rounding remainder.

revenueSplitLockingScript.name: Revenue split
revenueSplitLockingScript.description: The RevenueSplit contract: pays the whole coin to three fixed recipients at fixed basis points.

artistLockingScript.name: Artist
artistLockingScript.description: The artist P2PKH address of this split.

collaboratorLockingScript.name: Collaborator
collaboratorLockingScript.description: The collaborator P2PKH address of this split.

platformLockingScript.name: Platform
platformLockingScript.description: The platform P2PKH address of this split.
